ns2:section.sectionText: This year's workshop will focus on land use planning for the Kickapoo Rail-Trail extension into Urbana that is projected to extend from the East Main Street Spur to Lincoln Avenue. The class will also consider land use for a proposed Boneyard Pathway that would intersection with the Kickapoo Trail and extend to Lincoln Avenue as well. Students should be prepared to spend time several days on field trips. Intended for BAUSP seniors only. Graduate students with permission from instructor only.
